notes.title: New patch is out!
notes.notes:
In our newest patch we included:

- Chat system: global menu chat and in-game chat.
- Bot difficulties: easy, normal and hard bot difficulties.
- Improved tutorial
- Remake of our Warehouse level including new art and level design

- Bug fixes!

notes.title: New patch!
notes.notes:
We just released a new major patch to Gunjitsu. 

The patch includes a whole new [b]Weapon Level System[/b]. As you hit or kill opponents with the different weapons you gain [b]XP[/b] and [b]Levels[/b], which will unlock new bullet visuals.

The patch also includes a new game mode called [b]Race[/b]. Race is build on top of the Speedrun game mode. But in Race you will compete against friends and foes in order to complete an amount of laps fastest.

[b]New level![/b] Winter is a new small level with focus on intense fights for 2-3 players. Its set in a winter landscape environment.

Furthermore we reworked our Industry level completely with new art and level design.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[i]Content[/i]

Weapon level system
26 new bullet effects
Race game mode
New level: Winter
Reworked level: Industry 
New rematch system

[i]Bug fixes[/i]

Network: Wrong master client selection
Network: Wrong bot score
Race score bug
Wrong rematch level loaded
Rematch maps not showing
Rematch selection bug
Explosion effect bug
Looping particles
Explosion pooling bug
Game creation bug
Broken end game
Wrong match settings
Game filter bug
